tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (oṃ)༄༅/ /nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sbyin sreg gi yi ge rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /༈/rje btsun dam pa mi bskyod rdo rje'
(oṃ)༄༅/ /nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sbyin sreg gi yi ge rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /༈/rje btsun dam pa mi bskyod rdo rje'

tei:div.tei:p: (oṃ)༄༅// nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sbyin sreg gi yi ge rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༈ /rje btsun dam pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// bsam pa dag pas na tshe 'di nyid dam 'chi kha'am/ bar do'i 'gro ba ngan pas bar ma chod par skye ba phyi ma la mkha' spyod kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod pas/ 'di'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs chod cing nges pa thob nas/ rang gzhan gang gi don sgrub rung*/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub gang 'dod kyang bsnyen pa la 'bad par bya'o// de la rab 'bring tha ma gsum las/ dang po rab la'ang*/ rab dngos su yi dam lha'i gnang ba thob pa/ 'bring rmi lam du gnang ba thob pa/ tha ma gzhan du snying rje chen po skyes pas so// gnyis pa dus kyi la'ang*/ rab zla ba gsum/ 'bring gnyis/ tha ma gcig gsum pa grangs bsnyen la rab bzhi 'bum/ 'bring gsum 'bum/ tha ma 'bum phrag gcig ces gsungs pa'ang*/ gzhi bsnyen la bzhi 'bum nges par dgos pas phyi ma gnyis kha gso la dgongs so// de ltar bsnyen nas gzhan don brtsam na bzhi khri'am bzhi stong gi kha gsos nas gzhan don la 'jug par gsungs/ bsnyen pa sngon du song nas sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba'am/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i phyir sbyin sreg byed par 'dod na/ gang du byed pa'i gnas dben zhing nyams dga' bar/ sa chog rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ tha na'ang bsdus pa tsam nges par dgos te/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi lag len du bkod zin pas 'dir dran par bya'o// de lta bu'i sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs nas/ cho ga'i rim pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba la 'di'i thab ni bla dpe'i mchan gyi dpe ris ltar chos 'byung gru gsum gyi rnam pa zur rang la bstan pa/ de nas sor gsum gyis bskyed pa kha khyer yang sor gsum bskyed pa mu ran/ de gnyis kyi gzhi dmar po/

bcad dkar po nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ lte bar rdo rje dmar po mtshon spungs bya/ kha khyer la gri gug gi phreng ba/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng ba bris/ nang gi gru gsum la dga' ba 'khyil pa/ mu ran gru gsum zla phyed rdo rje gnyis bri'o// 'di las thams cad pa'i thab yin kyang*/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi bud shing dang yam shing so sor nges dgos so// 'di zhi ba la sbyar na/ thab kyi dbus su bud shing zlum por brtsigs pa/ me tshang bca' ba/ steng nas ku shas bkab pa rnams bde mchog gi skabs ltar ro// de nas g.yon bskor chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga tshan pa gnyis/ me lha 'jig rten pa dang 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor te gsum/ dri bzang dang bcas pa'i dung chos sam bum pa ku sha'i 'thor yab dang bcas pa bshams/ mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod dgang blugs rnams bde mchog ltar bsham/ de'i g.yas su dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa'i phyir mar/ sdig pa zhi ba'i phyir zhi ba la til nag 'byor pa thams cad rgyas pa la zho'am zas mchog khyad par tshe rgyas pa la dūr wa/ nor rgyas pa la 'bru sna tshogs/ dbang du byed pa la mngar gsum gyi ril bu/ drag po'i las sgrub na dug sna dang khrag sna dang*/ lan tshwa skye tshe la sogs pa sreg pa'i thal ba drag po'i rdzas gang yang rung ba re res kyang 'grub ces gsung yang 'dir bde mchog gi skabs ltar 'byor na rdzas thams cad dang*/ gang 'byor ba'i sreg rdzas rnams 'bul ba'i rim pa ltar bshams shing*/ lce lde rlung g.yab dang bcas pa legs par bsham mo// mchod rdzas sreg rdzas thams cad la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa'i nang mchod byin rlabs can gyis gtor la bzhag go /de nas skabs 'dir srung 'khor bde mchog ltar skad cig gis bsgom la sum+bha lan gcig brjod pas brtan par bsgom/ de nas rang nyid zhi ba'i chas gos dang ldan pa bdag bskyed bsgom pa nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang las/

phyag mtshan spangs pa'i rnal 'byor ma dga' ba'am dag pa gsum dang ldan pa'i nga rgyal gyis cho ga'i rim pa la 'jug go /de nas bsang chu sgrub pa ni bum bskyed bde mchog ltar bskyed pa'i nang ngam/ gsham nas dung chos dri ma med pa'i nang du hūm̐ las bsang chus rdzas rnams kyi bgegs dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes so// sum bha nyer bdun nam nyer gcig gis byin gyis brlabs pa ni spros pa chung na nang mchod rgyas bsdus gang yang rung bas byin gyis rlabs nas bsang chu zur pa med par nang mchod kyis bya'o// de nas mchod rdzas bsang sbyangs byin rlabs bde mchog ltar bya'o// gaṇ+ḍe ra ni med na spros pa chung ba la dgongs/ byed na'ang rung ngo*// de nas sreg rdzas rnams sum bhās bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ las sreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ bzang shing rgya che ba/ las so sor bsgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ shrī= dz+rīṃ= ku ru ku ru= zhes pas byin gyis rlabs/ spros pa la dga' na/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba sa ma pa de swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ badz+ra bi dzā ye= mahā be gā ya= mahā ba lā ya= badz+ra ghasma ri ye= oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ye= oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis rlabs pa kyai bde gnyis ka'i gong ma'i gsung rgyun na gda'o// mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i phyir rdzas bcu pa ni bde mchog skabs ltar ram/ yang na chang la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa la/ oṃ ma da na pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ba la pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis rlabs la byed gsung*/ de nas thab sum bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung chos 'byung gru gsum pa kha dog dmar po rgyar khru gang ba/

zabs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer la gri gug gi phreng ba dang*/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ zur rnams la zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang bar gyur/ de nas lce lde la me sbar/ sum bha zlos bzhin pa g.yon du lan gsum bskor nas me tshang du bcug oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes so// mar blugs gzar gang gis me gso la/ de nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ me lha dmar po ra skyes la bzhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pa bgrang phreng*/ g.yon dang pos dbyug gu rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i ril ba spyi blugs bsnams pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang tshangs pa'i skud pas mdzes par byas pa/ kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i lpags pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ sku la mdangs dang 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi lag pa g.yas g.yon mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya mthe bong srin lag gi rtsa bar bkug pa rna ba'i drung du g.yab/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha ye shes pa drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsams la/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi ma hā bhu ta de wa ri shi dwi dz+wa sarba ma ghi hi to mahā asmin pan+ni hi to bha wa ag+na ye e h+ye hi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mchod pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba= shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ de nas me lha mchod cing bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir ku sha bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang la bde mchog ltar bskyed/ thab kha'i phyogs mtshams su rim pa dang*/ rim pa las bzlog bkram/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yis kyang dag byed yin// 'dis bdag la gegs med par mdzod cig /ma ma shīn+taṃ kurban swā hā/ de nas me lha'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ bsam/ dgang blugs kyis kha la ram̐ bsam/ gzar bu gnyis pus mo gnyis bar du chud par byas te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing dgang blugs kyis bkang la/ gzar bu kha sbyar byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī pya dī pya/ a bhi sha a bhi sha/ ma hā shri ha bya ka bya bha ha na ye swā hā/ zhes pa gsum gyis zhal du sib sib phul/ de ltar byon zan phul nas/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra sngon song gi nyer spyod lnga/ de sngon song gis 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// de nas sreg rdzas rnams 'bul ba'i rim pa dgos pa dang bcas kyai bde gnyis ka'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg tu bkod pa der blta bar bya'o// de ltar rdzas gang du 'bul ba'i sngon du sum+bhas bsang*/ de nas lha sngags/ oṃ ag+na ye/ rdzas/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ya/ spel tshig ji ltar 'dod pa'am/ che ge mo mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad/ las sngags/ shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ myur bar 'dod na lha sngags sngags rdzas gsum mam/

lnga'am/ bdun nam/ nyer gcig sogs la spel tshig las sngags sbyar ro// 'dir lha sngags dang mar sngags gnyis gcig go /de lta bu'i sgo nas yam shing 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ zhu ba'i rdzas rnams zhal du/ gong bu'i rdzas rnams phyag tu/ dur+wa dang ku sha dbu'i gtsug tor la ji ltar 'tshams pa dmigs pa gsal zhing dad 'dun drag pos dbul nas gong bzhin phyi nang gis mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes mar blugs gzar gang phul ba'i rkyen gyis 'jig rten pa'i me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'i phyir/ me de bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las me 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar g.yon bskor gyis oṃ gsum mas bskor ba'i yig 'bru rnams las/ 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mngon rtogs gzhung bzhin gsal gdab/ gsal thebs nas mkha' 'gro mnyes shing dbang du sdud pa'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su bskor zhing*/ phaiṃ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdzod spu gnad kyi sgo phye nas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'khor rnal 'byor ma bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga zhes sgom don dang bcas pas dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa ro gcig tu 'dres/ de gnyis mi 'bral zhing brtan par bya ba'i phyir yum gyi go cha dgod/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ shrī tsakra sngon song gi nyer spyod lnga tsam gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā= zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/

sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa'am/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ de nas gong bzhin byon zan phul/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra sngon song gi chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga/ de sngon song la 'bru gsum btags pas mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis bstod/ bsreg rdzas rnams gong bzhin 'bul ba ni lha sngags oṃ gsum ma'am/ yum gyi nye snying gang la mos par 'bul lo// de yang oṃ nas phaṭa kyi rjes su rdzas sngags dang spel tshig dang*/ las sngags kyi mthar swā hā sbyar ba'o// myur bar 'dod na gong bzhin no// ba glang sha la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa byin rlabs can la/ bcu par mos na 'bul bar gtso bor byas te/ mkha' spyod go 'phang ni mchog gi dngos grub yin pas so// mchog gi yin kyang rung ste/ rdzas til nag la grangs 'dzin pa ni thun mong ba'o// de ltar bsreg rdzas ji ltar rigs pa phul nas/ sngar bzhin phyi nang gis mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ gtor ma bde mchog ltar rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gang rung ba byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ gsum ma la a kā ro btags pas lan gsum gyis phul/ phyi nang gis mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ de nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor yang 'dir bsngo/ de nas he ru ka'i yig brgya gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis rnal 'byor ma'i zhabs drung nas thal ba cung zad blangs nas dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar reg dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rje btsun ma rang la thim par mos/ go cha'i sngags lan gsum brjod pa brtan par mos/ de nas mar blugs gzar gang*/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes thab tu blugs pa'i rkyen gyis me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa las me lha'i rnam par gsal lam gyis gyur/ de nas sreg rdzas lhag ma ji ltar rigs pas phul/ sngar bzhin mchod/ gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar byin gyis brlabs/

oṃ ag+na ye na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo nas ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ gsum gyis phul/ de nas mchod bstod sngar bzhin phrin las bcol/ oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ rang gi gnas gsum sngar bzhin bsrung*/ yum gyi go cha dgod/ dag pa gsum gyi ngang las ma g.yos par las kyis rjes bsdu/ rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg 'di la thun mong ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ 'di thun mong ma yin pa'o// de la yang thab thig la brten pa dang*/ ma brten pa gnyis/ dang po la rgyas bsdus gnyis las rgyas pa'i phyag len no// bsdus pa ni gzhan rnams dkyus ltar yin la/ mgo mjug gi 'jig rten me lha mchod par dor te/ thab dbus su rje btsun ma yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa la byon zan nas brtsam te mchod bstod bsreg rdzas slar yang mchod bstod gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sogs mjug gi bya ba dkyus bzhin shes so// gnyis pa thab thig la ma brten pa mar me'i sbyin sreg ni sdong bu ras dmar gyis byas/ de'i rtse mo leb mor byas pa'i kong bu mar gyis bkang*/ 'byor zhing spro na de'i mthar mchod gtor tshes bcu bzhin bsham/ ma bsham kyang rung*/ de nas skyabs 'gro nas dga' ba gsum ldan gyi bar byas/ oṃ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ rnal 'byor ma yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ phyi nang gis mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ de'i rjes la lha sngags oṃ gsum ma/ rdzas sngags/ til sngags/ spel tshig las sngags dang bcas pa ci nus phul/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod phul/ gtor ma 'bul lam ma phul kyang rung*/ mdun gyi rnal 'byor ma rang gi lte ba'i bam̐ yig la bsdu/ yum gyi go cha bkod pa sogs mjug gi bya ba rnams snga ma bzhin no// de ltar 'bad pa'i dge ba rnams kyi mthus// dpag yas mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo rnal 'byor mas// brtse ba chen pos bdag rgyud byin rlabs te// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog
/ces rje btsun dam pa mus pa chen po'i gsung bzhin du sangs rgyas dpal bzang bas bris pa'o// /// ༈ /

rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa bzhugs// ༈ /oṃ swasti/ rje btsun bla ma mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i dbang phyug gi zhabs kyi pad+mo la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ blo chen khrag 'thung dges nyams gsal mdzad cing*// sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan zlos gar gyis// rnam gsum pho nya'i drwa ba rgya mtsho'i sprin// spro dang sdud mdzad khyod kyi thugs rjes skyongs// 'dir mkha' spyod don du gnyer ba'i gang zag gis bsnyen pa'i kha bskang ba dang rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib sbyong ba dang sngags kyi nus mthu 'byin pa dang mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub skye ba 'di nyid la thob pa'i phyir sbyin sreg gi cho ga la rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i sa phyogs kyi dbang du byas nas gnas khang byi dor dang*/ rten dang mchod pa'i yo byad ji ltar 'os pa bsham/ kha shar du phyogs par stan nang tshangs can gyi mdun du cog rtse sogs kyi khar rdor dril gyi bar du gzar bu gnyis kha sprad nas ma bral bar bzhag g.yas su ḍā ma ru dang me tog phor pa bsang chu'i dung phor 'thor yab dang bcas pa/ g.yon du nang mchod cog rtse'i mdun du me yol 'jim pa la dkar zhal byugs pa wam̐ bris pa bzhag mdun du zhi ba'i thab stegs zlum po brus pa'am rtsig pa gang 'thad mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar byas pa'i bskyed chog ltar gyi thab re khā dkar po'i chos 'byung gi dbus su rdo rje dmar po'am tshom bu dmar po srog chags med pa'i lci ba skam pos khru phyed tsam zlum por brtsigs pa'i nang gi shar lhor zan gyi ting lo'i me tshang bshams/ rang gi g.yas phyogs su stegs gtsang ma'i khar bsreg rdzas yam shing sor bcu gnyis pa'i tshad mthe bong las mi sbom zhing*/

mthe'u chung las mi phra bar/ rtsa rtse mar dang bu ram gyis byugs pa/ mar/ til/ zas mchog 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ dūr+wa/ ku sha/ chang la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa/ ba glang gi sha dum la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa rnams bzhag rang gi g.yon phyogs su stegs gtsang ma'i khar 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga tshar gnyis bshams/ thab kyi mthar bkram rgyu'i sku sha'i chun po brgyad/ me sbar ba'i lce lde/ me gso ba'i bud shing skam po rlung g.yab dang bcas pa sogs yo byad thams cad ma tshang ba med pa bshams/ de yang bsod nams kyi tshogs bsogs par 'dod na yar ngo*/ bar chad 'joms par 'dod pas mar ngo ste/ tshes bcu gnyis gang yang rung ba'i dus khyad par can nam/ dus gang yang rung ba'i snga dro'am dgong mo'i cha la stan bde ba la bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis 'dug ste/ sum+bha ni tshar gsum gyis srung 'khor gsal btab nas skyabs 'gro nas bsam mi khyab kyi thun bsdu ba'i bar gyis bdag bskyed grub rjes/ nang mchod nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis 'thor rjes bsang chu bsgrub pa ni/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sham̐ las byung ba'i dung phor dri ma med pa'i nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i bsang chu rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ sum+bha ni nyer gcig gam bdun gyis byin gyis brlab bo// 'di man gyi bsang ba rnams la bsang chu kho nar 'thor ba yin/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la nas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da nas/ badz+ra s+pha ra kham̐ phyag rgyar bcas pa brjod cing*/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta tshar gsum gyis rol chen ḍā dril dang bcas pas byin gyis rlobs/ bsreg rdzas rnams kyang sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ las bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa las so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

oṃ āḥswā hā/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ tshar res byin gyis brlabs/ spros pa la dga' na/ oṃ bho dhi bṛk+ṣa ye sogs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gyis rdzas sngags tshar re brjod/ yang thab la dmigs te sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po/ rgyar khru gang ba/ dpangs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer la gri gug gi phreng bas bskor ba'i nang e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi zur rnams su zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang bar gyur/ de nas me bsgrub pa ni bram ze rgyun bzhag gi me las sngar gyi lce lde sbar la/ lag pa gnyis kyis bzung ste/ oṃ gsum ma bzla bzhin pas thab la g.yon nas lan gsum bskor zhing me tshang du bcug oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod/ me gso ba'i rtsa skam cung zad bzhag yang sngags de nyid brjod cing*/ mar blugs gzar gsum blugs te me gso/ de nas 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me de nyid bsang sbyangs gong bzhin las/ stong pa'i ngang las me 'bar ba'i dbus su ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ me lha dmar mo ra skyes la bzhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gyi dang pos dbyug gu rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang tshangs pa'i skud pas mdzes par byas pa/ khri snyan sa le'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs dang dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ sku las mdangs dang 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha ye shes pa drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/

lag pa g.yas dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi/ ma hā bhu ta de wa re ṣi di dzaḥ sa twa ma ghi hi to ma hā asmin sin/ hi to bha wa/ ag+na ye e h+ye hi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ ku sha bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse gnyis ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// des bdag la gegs med par mdzod// ma ma shīn+taṃ kurban swā hā/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad du byas pa phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor gyis bkram/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ bsams la dgang blugs kha la'ang ram̐ bsam/ gzar bu gnyis pus mo gnyis kyi bar du tshud par byas te/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing mar blugs gzar gyis dgang gzar bkang la gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar te g.yon du bskor zhing me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsams la/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī pya a dī pya a bhi ṣa ma hā shri ha bya ka bya bha ha na ye/

bdag gi mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ de ltar byon zan gsum slar 'jig rten las 'das pa dang 'dra bar bdun gsum re yang phul/ phul nas phyag rgyar bcas pas/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga shab+da rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pā ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gi nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par bstod// skabs 'dir me pra brtags la/ ngan na bsang chu 'thor zhing*/ sum+bha ni brjod pas bsrung*/ de nas bsreg rdzas kyi snod lag pa g.yon pas bzung*/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs la g.yon pa'i 'og nas bskor zhing*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swā hā/ zhes pas rdzas kyang lan bdun sogs ci rigs dbul/ de bzhin du sha dum bar thams cad 'bul ba'i tshe mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ ag+na ye bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye bdag gi sdig sgrib bar chad dang sngags kyi nyes pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes gsum tsam dang*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swā hā zhes rdzas sngags rkyang pa bdun sogs ci rigs pa phul/ de bzhin du shab+da'i bar thams cad la thog mtha' bar gsum du sngags gsum ka sbrel ba dang*/ gzhan rdzas sngags rkyang pa bdun sogs grangs mnyam pa phul te/ rdzas sngags ni oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ mar dang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ til dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zas mchog dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swā hā/ so ba/ oṃ ma hā be ga ye swā hā/ nas/ oṃ mahā ba la ye swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri ye swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūr+wa/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra swā hā/

ku sha oṃ ma dā na pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ chang dang*/ oṃ ba la pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ ba glang gi sha dum gyi sngags so// yang gong bzhin phyi nang gis mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes mar blugs gzar gang dbul ba'i rkyen gyis me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha bskyed pa ni/ me bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du bam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar g.yon skor gyis/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ zhes pa nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i nye lam las 'byung ba ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su ji lta ba bzhin bskyed/ dmigs pa gong bzhin dang bcas oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye a di pya sogs kyis byon zan dbul/ bum bskyed ltar mchod bstod bya/ spro na rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi sgo nas bstod/ bsreg rdzas rnams gong bzhin dbul ba ni/ oṃ gsum ma lha sngags/ oṃ bo dho bṛk+ṣa ye rdzas sngags/ sham bu'i spel tshig las sngags te/ de lta bu nyer gcig gam bdun tsam gyis dbul ba sogs gong 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i skabs bzhin dbul/ de yang yam shing me 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ mar dang chang sogs zhu ba'i rdzas rnams zhal du/ til sogs gong bu'i rdzas rnams phyag tu/ dūr+wa dang ku sha dbu'i gtsug tor du phul bar bsam/ lha sngags dngos gzhi'i bsreg rdzas rnams 'bul ba'i dmigs pa ni/ nam mkha'i khams sangs rgyas byang sems kyis gang ba sku mdog dkar po phyag na ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pas bdag la dbang bskur zhing sdig sgrib ma lus pa dag nas/ lus ye shes kyi bdud rtsis mer gyi khengs te rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang mngon du byas snyam pa'i ting nge 'dzin ma yengs par bya zhing mdun bskyed kyi sku las kyang 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas bdag dang bsgrub bya la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs par bsam/

yang gzhan don du byed na mdun bskyed kyi mdun du pad zla'i gdan la bsgrub bya gang yin pa de rgyan gos dkar pos brgyan pa'am/ lus la mdun bskyed kyi spro bsdus sdig sgrib sbyangs par bsam/ 'di'i rdzas kyang rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i yi ger cung mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug kyang*/ til kho nas oṃ gsum ma gang 'gro re dbul zhing*/ sngags kyang lha sngags kho nas dbul ba/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang bsnyen pa kha bskang ba'i sngags lha rang rang gi dgos kyi rdzas sngags lha sngags ma yin pa'i phyir ro// de'i phyag len rje sems dpa' chen pos bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag len du gdams pa yin no// mthar yang gong bzhin rdzas tshang ba bdun tsam phul/ yang gong ltar mchod bstod/ skabs 'dir gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas dbul ba'i bar thams cad dkyil chog ltar bya'o// mkha' 'gro spyi gtor yang spro na dkyus bzhin bya/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sogs kyi dngos grub blangs/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs dang*/ bdag las dang po pas sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs kyis mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thal ba cung zad blangs la gnas gsum du byugs shing*/ dam tshig pa bdag la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bam̐ sogs nas go cha'i lha sngags rkyang pa tshar gsum brjod cing gsal gdab/ yang mar blugs gzar gang phul zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes brjod pas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa las rang gzugs su byon par gyur/ yang gshegs skyems mar phul nas bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams gong ltar phul/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod gtor ma oṃ ag+na ye'i mthar/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ phyi nang gis mchod/ me de bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag

/shar lho gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// me lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis phrin las bcol/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol/ oṃ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// bsgrub kyi bzhud kyis byin za khyod// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad bsgrub// oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ thal ba sngar bzhin blangs la/ dam tshig pa rang la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ zhes brjod cing gnas gsum bsrung*/ yang go cha'i sngags sngar bzhin brjod/ las bsags pa don dang ldan pa'i phyir bsngo ba smon lam mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i bar rgyun gyi nyams len bzhin dang*/ phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi dpal mnga' ba sogs bkra shis brjod/ me tog gi char dbab/ sbyin sreg nyi ma sbrel nas byed na thal ba rnams dkrugs rdal du ma song ba'i sngar gyi thal ba de nan pa byas nas khar lci ba brtsigs te/ cho ga rnams ni gong ji lta ba bzhin mdzad/ grol ba'i nyin tshogs 'khor mdzad pa'i tshogs rdzas rnams phyag len bzhin bshams nas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha'i gtor 'bul tshar ma thag gtor ma byin rlabs ltar byin gyis rlabs nas sngags 'bul yan chad dkyus bzhin mdzad/ dam tshig spel ba dang tshogs la longs spyod pa ni 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i dam tshig pa rang la bsdus nas gnas gsum bsrung*/ go cha'i lha sngags brjod pa yan grub nas mdzad/ tshogs lhag nas bkra shis kyi bar tshes bcu'i mchod pa ltar mdzad pas grub cing*/ thal shul chu dang 'o mas bkru zhing thal ba rnams mi phyugs mang pos 'thung ba'i chu bo'am ri mthon po'i rtser gdan drangs par bya'o// de ltar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi yi ge rje sa chen yab sras sogs kyis mdzad pa'i yig rnying dang*/

kun mkhyen go bo rin po ches mdzad pa dang*/ gtso bor rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i yi ger gzhir bzhag der mi gsal ba rnams bde kye'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg nas kha 'gengs par gsungs pa bzhin kha bskang*/ bla ma yab sras kyi gsung rgyun dang phyag len gyi rim pa go bde bar byas/ don la rang bzo'i dri mas ma bslad par sbyar ba 'di ni tshul 'di la mos pa'i don gnyer gyis bskul ba'i ngor rgyal khams kyi bya bral ba dbang phyug rab brtan gyis yul dbus kyi sa'i sman ljongs rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i sras kyi thu bo rdo rje btsun mo nyid kyis ring nas bskyangs pa'i gnyan ston mchog gi sprul pa'i zlos gar rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa gzhon nu blo gros kyi zhal snga nas 'debs par mdzad pa'i bkra shis dang dge mtshan du mas phyug pa'i chos sde snyan brgyud zab mo'i chos sgra rgyun mi 'chad par sgrog pa'i gnas/ rje btsun de nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs shing gdan chags pa'i gzim chung du sbyar ba'o// 'dis kyang slob bshad zab mo'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /shu bhaṃ// ༈ /

thar rtse paṇa chen gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru bud+dha sidhā ya/ shes rab mchog gi lha mo dang*// mi 'gyur bde chen kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /zung 'jug phyag rgya la btud de// sbyin sreg lag len bshad kyis nyon// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// sngags kyi nus pa 'byung ba'i phyir// zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed pa la// sa yongs su sbyangs pa'i gnas su thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab/ de'i dbus su khru phyed kyis zlum skor dang*/ de'i phyi rol du sor bzhi pa gnyis bskor ba'i zlum skor gsum ste thab nang kha khyer mu ran dang*/ de'i phyi rol du thab stegs spyi dang mthun pa'i nang du dbus su srad bu bzung ste/ de nas dbus bar gyi srad bu des zlum skor dang po'i g.yas g.yon gyis gang slebs su rtags bya/ nub tu yang snga ma'i rigs pas rtags bya/ de steng thig gdab pas chos 'byung nyis brtsegs 'byung*/ de'i mdun rgyab kyi grwa spangs pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du 'khor ba/ gzhi tshon thams cad dkar po/ chos 'byung gi nang dmar po/ bcad dmar skyas bri/ dbus su nyi gdan gyi steng du tshon phung dmar po dgod/ kha khyer gyi steng du bud shing phru phyed tsam brtsegs pa'i shar lhor ting lo rtswa skam po dang bcas pa bsham/ thab kyi nub tu stan la 'dug pa'i rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas su chu gnyis nyer spyod dang gtor ma gnyis bsham/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon du yam shing*/ mar til/ zho mar phye bsres pa'i zas mchog ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i ril bu/ dūr+wa/ ku sha rnams brgya rtsa re dang*/ til la grangs 'dzin pas gang mang bsham mo// mdun du nang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu dgang blugs gzar kha sbyar te bzhag go /phyi ma red kyi dus su/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs nas rang nyid rje btsun ma'i skur gyur zhes rje rat+na ni rā bho gas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o// de nas thab dang mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor zhing*/

sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med par mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ phyi rol du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ hūm̐ yang yang brjod pas byin gyis rlabs/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog nas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las bsgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsreg rdzas dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis rlob/ rtswa gtsang ma dang bcas pa'i yam shing gi rtse la me spar te gus pa'i tshul gyis/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod/ thab la g.yas phyogs nas lan gsum bskor te me tshang du gzhug de nas byang chub phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung la/ blugs gzar mar dang bcas pa dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing blugs gzar gyis mar bud shing la khyab par blugs te/ oṃ dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis me gso/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su pad+ma dkar po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ram̐ las me lha ra skyes la bzhon pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gyis dang pos dbyug gu rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pas gaṇ+ḍi 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan zhing tshangs pa'i skud pa dang*/ kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/

rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ zhes spyan drangs nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ ljags las 'od zer byung bas byon zan gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes bdun brjod pa'i rjes su/ oṃ ag+na ye sarba pā paṃ shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar gang ba de 'dra ba lan gsum gyis byon zan phul/ oṃ ag+na ye zhes pa kun la sbyar ba'i/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ ag+na ye oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// sogs kyis bstod/ 'bar ba'i me 'od la dbul bar bsam/ yam shing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes bdun nam nyer gcig gi mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye sarba pā paṃ shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hās phul/ mar yang sngags 'di 'ba' dmigs pa gong gi byon zan dang 'dra/ zhig gis gong ltar phul/ til zas 'di rnams zhal du phul/ mchog mngar gsum gyi ril bu/ dūr+wa ku 'di gnyis dbu'i gtsug tu phul bar bsam/ sha rnams phul/ slar yang mchod bstod sngar ltar byas nas mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes phul bas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur bar bsam/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su e yig nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon bskor du 'khor ba'i dbus su skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma pad+ma dang nyi ma zhes sogs nas/

tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo zhes bsam nas/ phaiṃ thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer sogs nas gnyis su med par thim zhes sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// de nas/ oṃ gsum ma lan bdun brjod pa'i phaṭa kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byon zan phul/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī zhes re re sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ḍā dril phyi mchod/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs sh+lau ka gnyis kyis bstod/ de nas bsregs rdzas rnams oṃ gsum ma 'ba' zhig brgya rtsa brgyad kyis phul/ mar/ til/ zas mchog mngar gsum/ dūr+wa ku sha rnams gong ltar phul/ til bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad snying ga'i bam̐ la kaṃ nag po brgyud mar byung ste sna sgor sleb pa dang sdig pa rwa can gyi gzugs su gyur nas mdun gyi til la thim pas lha'i zhal du til zag med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur nas phul ba sdig sgrib 'dag nges kyi nges shes brtan po'i ngang nas phul/ la grangs 'dzin pas sngags 'bum phrag bzhi song ba'i kha bskang du til khri phrag bzhi 'bul lo// slar yang mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ gtor ma dang po bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i sogs nas 'dod don gsol ba btab pa sgrub thabs nang bzhin bya zhing spyan 'dren mi dgos so// yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes brjod/ thab kyi thal ba zhig blangs te rang gi dpral bar thig le bya'o// slar yang thab nang du mar blugs gzar gang blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes pa nas/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam par gyur/ de la yam shing sogs bdun nam nyer gcig phul nas/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/

gtor ma gnyis pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥs byin gyis rlabs nas/ oṃ ag+na ye na lag g.yas mchog sbyin phyag rgya bya/ maḥsarba ta thā ga sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra muḥye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du oṃ bam̐/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes pas bsrung*/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra la sogs pa'i bkra shis dang*/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig sogs kyi bsngo ba smon lam bya'o// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi lag len 'di ni/ dge slong bsod nams brtson 'grus pas yang yang bskul nas/ brang ti pa'i bhik+ṣu ga ga na shrī bha dras shing mo lug gi lo/ dpyid zla 'bring po'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu gsum nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor 'dzom pa'i nyin shrī e waṃ thar pa rtser sbyar ba'o// 'di'i mchan bu rnams mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
